correctness.rationale: Over complex numbers the smooth Fermat cubic E:x^3+y^3+z^3=0 is met to order 3 by each line x+omega^j*y=0, so each union point is two smooth branches tangent to order 3, analytically A5; the two distinct lines meet away from E transversely as A1, giving tau=5+5+1=11. For F=E*(x+y)*(x+omega*y), independent polynomial reduction modulo omega^2+omega+1 verified the explicit quadratic identity A F_x+B F_y+D F_z=0. An independently constructed 21-by-9 coefficient matrix of all degree-one polynomial Jacobian syzygies, reducing omega to 2 modulo 7, has rank 9, so mdr(F)=2 in characteristic zero (and degree-zero impossible). For d=5,r=2, the du Plessis-Wall near-free numeric criterion gives 16-2(2)-1=11 and exponents (2,3). Projective cyclic symmetry covers all pairs. Full-three-line free sextic is known; one-line quartic has tau 5 and fails numerical near-free criterion. Finite modular rank is an exact nonvanishing minor certificate, not finite sampling for an infinite assertion.
